title: MMD_materials_outline v0.1 draft
description: Independent outline on a glTF 2.0 material. Presence enables it. Defaults are annotations, applied by consumers on omission.

colorFactor.description: Finite PMX source edge RGBA, preserved without compensation; runtime clamping and provisional encoded RGB semantics are defined in the rendering chapter. Alpha is linear coverage.

sizeFactor.description: Finite signed PMX source material edge size, preserved unchanged; not inherently a pixel width. The provisional rendering equation converts its product with vertex scale to displacement.
